title: The Sign That Changed Its Meaning · 新情境写作
instructions: 独立写至少120词。再按真实反馈订正；不要照抄源文。同一提示再次使用属于订正或巩固，不冒充未见任务。
prompt:
Write a short paragraph (about 120 words) about a time when a sign or map in your city was confusing. Describe where it was, what it said, and what you think should change. Use at least three position prepositions and one comparison.
Write at least 120 words. Use your own new details. Do not copy the source text.
